given: records written at different moments for one Organization
when: a Staff Member opens the log
then: the records come newest first and the last one written is at the top
test_name: recent_records_come_newest_first

given: a Staff Member whose role carries audit.read — the shipped Owner and Manager, or a role the Organization composed with it
then: it opens; a Staff Member without audit.read reads nothing, the destination is absent from their rail, and the page reached by URL says reading it is a permission, who can grant it, and that a Property assignment may be what is missing, never that the Subscription lacks the module (ADR 0031); with the switcher on a Property they cannot read it from while there is one they can, it says to choose that one instead
test_name: audit_read_is_what_opens_the_log; audit_location_reach.test.sql: without audit.read the Organization's records are closed, even at the reader's own Property; audit-log-page.test.tsx: tells somebody without audit.read it is a permission; audit-log-page.test.tsx: sends somebody who may read it elsewhere to the switcher; audit-log.spec.ts: a viewer without audit.read has no destination and a direct URL reads nothing

given: records exist for an Organization the Staff Member has no membership in
when: they ask for that Organization's log
then: nothing comes back and the answer is the same as for an Organization that does not exist
test_name: audit_location_reach.test.sql: an owner of another Organization reads none of these; a_property_out_of_reach_reads_nothing

given: the Staff Member holds active memberships in two Organizations that both have records
then: only that Organization's records come back; the policy alone would let both through, which is why the read names the Organization itself
test_name: recent_records_are_bounded_to_the_organization_asked_for

given: a role that carried audit.read no longer does
when: somebody holding it opens the log
then: nothing comes back; the permission is asked by the read policy in the same statement as the read
test_name: audit_location_reach.test.sql: taking audit.read out of the role closes the log, in the read policy itself; taking_audit_read_out_of_a_role_closes_the_log

given: a check-in or a Folio line was reversed with a reason
then: the record names the actor and carries the reason, and a Folio reversal carries the amount, currency and description it took off
test_name: a_reversal_is_traceable_to_its_actor_and_reason; folios.test.ts: follows a reversal down, keeping both lines; audit-log.spec.ts: a correction is traced to the person who made it and the reason they gave

given: the Organization's Subscription is cancelled, or no package includes anything about audit
then: it still opens: audit is a baseline right (blueprint 3.6) and no commercial gate stands in front of it
test_name: a_lapsed_subscription_does_not_close_the_log

given: the Property belongs to another Organization or the Staff Member is not assigned to it
when: they open the log through that Property
then: nothing comes back and the answer is the same as for a Property that does not exist
test_name: a_property_out_of_reach_reads_nothing

situation: An action the screen has no word for
given: a module writes an action name the workspace catalogue does not know
then: the raw action name is shown, never a blank; the label is added in the same commit as the writer
test_name: an_unknown_action_renders_as_its_own_name

given: records by the viewer and by colleagues
then: the viewer's own rows say so and a colleague is named by their address; an actor the viewer may not see is shown by the first eight characters of their id, never blank
test_name: the_actor_is_named_by_their_address; the_viewer_is_named_and_colleagues_by_address

given: records at Properties in different timezones
then: each time is the wall clock of the Property where it happened; a record about the whole Organization uses the opened Property's clock, and the screen says so
test_name: times_are_each_propertys_own

situation: A page reaching the module directly
given: a file outside src/server imports the platform audit module at runtime
then: the build fails on the funnel rule
test_name: dependency-boundaries.mjs: the funnel rule covers every platform module

situation: A record written while the page is open
given: a colleague reverses a charge after the list loaded
when: the reader looks at the list
then: it is not there until the page is loaded again; nothing on this screen is live (ADR 0019 is the arrivals poll and is not applied here)
test_name: audit-log.spec.ts: a record written while the page is open is not there until it is loaded again

given: there is no signed-in viewer
then: nothing comes back (ADR 0007)
test_name: audit-log.spec.ts: without a session the log is not served and the record is not read

given: any record
then: no record is changed or removed; the trigger and the revoked grants refuse it whoever asks
test_name: platform_audit.test.sql: the runtime role cannot update a record; the migration role cannot rewrite a record either

given: a Manager with audit.read, assigned to one Property of several
then: they read that Property's records and none of the others', and no record about the whole Organization
test_name: an_assigned_reader_reads_only_their_properties; organization_wide_records_belong_to_organization_wide_readers

given: an Owner, whose reach is organization_wide
then: every Property's records and every record about the whole Organization — a role defined or somebody revoked
test_name: organization_wide_records_belong_to_organization_wide_readers

given: a Property with records has since been archived
when: an Organization-wide reader opens the log
then: its records are still there and still named; history outlives the hotel
test_name: an_archived_propertys_history_stays_readable_and_named

given: a Front desk member checks a Guest in
then: the record is written and the writer can read back its own record, and nobody else's
test_name: audit_location_reach.test.sql: but a writer without audit.read still records, and reads back what it wrote; and sees only that: its own record, nobody else's

situation: A record in the wrong place
given: a writer names a Property of another Organization as a record's location
then: refused by the insert policy
test_name: audit_location_reach.test.sql: a record cannot name another Organization's Property

given: a caller supplies occurred_at
then: refused: the runtime role may write eight columns and the time is not one of them
test_name: audit_location_reach.test.sql: a record cannot be backdated: occurred_at is not a column the runtime role may write

given: a reader narrows by action, by one Property, or by a day range
then: the server applies them over every record the reader may see; the days mean the opened Property's calendar
test_name: narrows_by_action; narrows_to_one_property; narrows_by_day_in_the_propertys_clock

given: a reader types a Guest's name, a room, a colleague's address or words from a reason, in any case, a dotted İ included
then: records about that Guest's Reservations, Stays and Folios, that room, that colleague, or with those words in the reason or in a fact the record carries — a charge's description — as far as the reader may see
test_name: finds_a_guest_a_room_a_colleague_and_a_reason; a_search_cannot_reach_past_the_readers_reach; a submitted search finds a record by its reason (tests/browser/audit-log.spec.ts)

given: a reader types one character
then: the search is not run and the screen says why, rather than showing every record as though it matched
test_name: audit-log.spec.ts: a one-character search is not run and the screen says why

given: a filter that is not a uuid, a day that does not exist, or a cursor that is not one
then: the filter narrows to nothing or is ignored — a non-uuid, a day that does not exist, year 0, a cursor that is not one or is too large, a NUL in the search — and a bad cursor starts at the top; never an error
test_name: a_filter_from_an_edited_url_narrows_to_nothing_rather_than_failing

given: more records match than one page holds
then: every record appears exactly once across the pages, the count is the same on each, and records written in the same millisecond are not skipped at a page boundary
test_name: walks_every_record_once_with_the_same_total_on_every_page

given: records written before 20260916004200 carry no location
then: they read as about the whole Organization: visible to Organization-wide readers and to whoever wrote them, never back-filled, because back-filling means rewriting an append-only table
test_name: organization_wide_records_belong_to_organization_wide_readers

given: a check-in, a withdrawal, a departure, a booking, a charge, a reversal, a closure, a room added, blocked or unblocked, or a Property assigned
then: the record carries the Property it happened at, so exactly that Property's readers see it; dropping the location would hide it from them
test_name: front-office.test.ts, check-in-reversal.test.ts, folios.test.ts, staff.test.ts, accommodation-audit.test.ts (latestRecord … locationId)

given: somebody's role is changed, or a role's permissions are edited
then: a role change records what it changed from and to; a permission edit records what was added and what was removed (blueprint 7.4); each role key says whether it was the Organization's own, because an authored role's key is a slug of its name and can equal a shipped one's, and the log reads it that way
test_name: staff.test.ts: may demote themselves when they are not the last; ends the sessions of everybody holding a role that changes; staff.test.ts: records which role was meant when an authored key is a shipped one's; audit-screen.test.tsx: an Organization's own role is named as its own, even with a shipped key

situation: A context that is not an object
given: a record whose context is a JSON string or array — nothing in the schema forbids one
then: the search runs and that record simply does not match on its context
test_name: a_record_whose_context_is_not_an_object_does_not_break_search

given: somebody wrote records and their membership was revoked
then: nothing, not even their own records
test_name: audit_location_reach.test.sql: a revoked Staff Member no longer reads even the records they wrote

given: any record the reader may read
then: the whole reason and every context fact are shown in the reader's language — money with its currency, rooms, Guests, roles and permissions by name — and a Folio subject links to its Folio; a housekeeping mark says the room's status before and after, and an inspection setting what it was and became, in the Housekeeping screen's words
test_name: audit-screen.test.tsx: a room's status change says before and after; an inspection setting says what it was and became

given: a link to a record, however many records were written since
then: it opens, read by id; a record that does not exist, is in another Organization, or is not the reader's to read gives one answer
test_name: opens_a_record_by_id_however_old

given: an Owner opens the audit log on a phone
then: the five filters are folded behind one button that says how many are on, and each record says who did it under what happened, so records are what is on the first screen
test_name: shell-width.spec.ts: the audit log on a phone folds its filters and shows who did it

given: a Staff Member with access_scope assigned_properties and one assignment
then: before ADR 0031 they read every Property's records; now only their own Property's, and the old test is inverted rather than removed
test_name: an_assigned_reader_reads_only_their_properties

given: users_read_self_and_colleagues already lets a Staff Member read a colleague's address (20260916002200)
then: blocks: s3. Resolved: the log names the actor by address, read at read time
test_name: the_actor_is_named_by_their_address

given: audit.records carried organization_id only
then: resolved: location_id (ADR 0031)
test_name: an_assigned_reader_reads_only_their_properties

given: roles are named sets of permissions (ADR 0026)
when: only some roles should open the log
then: resolved: audit.read
test_name: audit_read_is_what_opens_the_log

given: an Organization has more records than a page
when: the reader wants the older ones
then: resolved: keyset pages on (occurred_at; id)
test_name: walks_every_record_once_with_the_same_total_on_every_page

given: the log is wanted outside the product
then: out of scope: Organization Data export is blueprint 3.6 and its own feature

given: a sign-in fails or succeeds
when: the reader looks for it in the log
then: out of scope: an authentication has no Organization — a failed one has no user either — so it belongs to security logging (blueprint 7.6) and not to an Organization's audit trail

given: somebody accepts a staff invitation
then: deferred: acceptance is not an authorization boundary (the membership is active from the invitation, SP-S1-07), and recording it needs the accepting definer to write the record in its own transaction

situation: Two edits of one role at the same instant
given: two administrators change the same person's role, or edit the same role, concurrently
then: deferred: the before-value is read without a row lock, so the later record's from or removed may describe the state the earlier edit replaced. Locking it first would take the membership lock ahead of the last-administrator trigger that locks every membership, which is the ordering that deadlocks the race tested in staff.test.ts

situation: A record's subject opens where it can be opened
given: a record whose subject is a folio, a room or bed, a Property, an Organization or a data export, and a viewer who may open that screen
when: the list or the record is read
then: the subject is a link to that screen, keeping the Property; a subject whose screen the viewer cannot open is plain text, not a link to a refusal; a reservation or a stay, which no screen shows alone, links to every record about it in the log
test_name: audit-ux.test.tsx: AL-S2-04: a folio opens Finance and a room opens Rooms, keeping the Property; AL-S2-04: a reservation, which no screen shows alone, opens its own history in the log; AL-S2-04: a subject whose screen the viewer cannot open is text, not a link to a refusal

given: a booking, a stay or a folio, asked for by its id
when: the log is opened with that subject
then: it lists every record about it and about the other two of the three that belong with it, narrows rather than finds (a text cannot widen it), says on a banner what it is the history of and how to show everything, and is empty for an id that is not one, another Organization's thing, or one the viewer's reach does not cover; every record offers a link to its subject's history
test_name: audit-log.test.ts: AL-S2-04: a booking's history is its own records and its stay's and its folio's; AL-S2-04: asked of a thing with no relations it is that thing alone, and narrows rather than finds; AL-S2-04: another Organization's folio, and an id that is not one, have no history here; AL-S2-04: the history stays inside the reader's reach; audit-log.spec.ts: a subject opens where it can be opened, a booking's history spans its stay and folio, and the way back is one press

situation: The details table speaks the reader's language
given: a record whose context carries the facts a module wrote
then: every fact has a name in the three languages or is hidden on purpose (the database's own change id) or is shown by the action's own layout; a fact carried as nothing reads "not set" and not "None"; the table's caption is for a screen reader only; a writer's new fact fails the build until it is one of the three
test_name: audit-writers.test.ts: every fact a writer records is named, hidden or shown by the action's own layout; audit-ux.test.tsx: AL-S2-06: calls a missing departure not set, names every fact of an amendment, and keeps its caption for a screen reader only

situation: Finding an action by the word for it, and listing actions by area
given: fifty-odd actions, and a reader who thinks in the words on the screen
when: they search, or open the action filter
then: the search text also finds the actions whose name it is part of, in their language and spelling ("rates" finds "Nightly rates changed"), still narrowed by the dates and reach; the action filter lists the actions under seven headings; one word is used for a reservation and one for a room or bed across the log in every language
test_name: audit-log.test.ts: AL-S2-07: an action the host names is found by the text that names it; audit-ux.test.tsx: AL-S2-07: a word on the screen finds the action it names, in each language; audit-log.spec.ts: a word on the screen finds the action it names, the actions are listed under headings, and text too short to search says so in its field

situation: What a setting or price change was, in the list
given: records of a setting switched, a Property or Organization setting, a Maintenance setting, a price list, a role, a room status, a departure, an arrival time, a charge or a payment
then: a line under what happened says what it was and became ("Off → On", "Room: No price → ₺1.750,00"), in the language and with the arrow turned the way it reads, so seven records of one setting can be told apart without opening each; a record that is none of these has no line
test_name: audit-ux.test.tsx: AL-S2-08: a setting switched seven times says to what, so the rows can be told apart; AL-S2-08: a price change names the kind and both prices, and a kind that had none says so; audit-log.spec.ts: a setting changed seven times says to what in the list, a stay's departure reads as dates, and the record names every fact

situation: Which clock the times are on
given: a list whose records are all at Properties on one clock, or at Properties on several
then: the When column's heading names the Property whose clock it is, in words and never as a zone id, or says each place's own clock when there are several; a record names the Property under its time; a time in the current year carries no year
test_name: audit-ux.test.tsx: AL-S2-09: names the Property whose clock the one zone is, in words, and says each place's own when there are two; audit-ux.test.tsx: AL-S2-09: never prints a zone's id, which in Arabic is Latin text inside a right-to-left heading; audit-ux.test.tsx: AL-S2-09: a time in the current year carries no year, and one in an earlier year does; audit-ux.test.tsx: AL-S2-09: a record opened by its link says whose clock its time is on, even for the whole Organization

situation: A search that names more than is looked at
given: a search text that names more Guests, rooms or colleagues than the limit of 200 each
then: the screen says records about the rest are not shown and to search for something more specific, so "nothing matched" and "that was too broad" do not look alike; a search that stays under the limit says nothing
test_name: audit-log.test.ts: AL-S2-10: a search that names more Guests than it looks at says so, and one that does not, does not

situation: A long reason in the list
given: a record with a reason of several sentences
when: the list is read at a laptop or tablet width
then: the Why cell has a width of its own and shows two lines, cut by the cell and not mid-word at the edge of the table; the record shows it whole
test_name: audit-ux.test.tsx: AL-S2-11: is held to a width of its own and two lines, so it is cut by the cell and not by the table's edge; audit-log.spec.ts: the reason is cut by its own cell, the time says which clock it is on, and the log points to the export

situation: The log points to the export
given: a reader who holds audit.read and may request an audit export at this Property
then: a link opens the Data export screen with the audit log chosen and the days they were looking at as its range; a reader who may not request an export is shown no link
test_name: audit-log.spec.ts: the reason is cut by its own cell, the time says which clock it is on, and the log points to the export

given: one character typed in Search
then: the message is in the search field and no list is shown under it that could be read as its answer
test_name: audit-log.spec.ts: a word on the screen finds the action it names, the actions are listed under headings, and text too short to search says so in its field

given: a booking in the Reservations list opened in its sheet, and a viewer who may read the Audit log at the Property
then: the Audit log opens at the Property filtered to that booking (?subject=); a viewer who may not read the Audit log is not offered the link (AUDIT-03)
test_name: a_booking_opens_its_history_for_a_viewer_who_may_read_the_audit_log_and_for_nobody_else

given: a payment posted, which the ledger stores as a credit (a negative amount)
when: the list or the record shows it
then: it reads as the money received, without a minus sign; a reversal keeps its sign because there the sign says which way the money went
test_name: audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-02: reads without a minus sign in the list and in the details table, in every language; audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-02: keeps the sign on a reversal, where it says which way the money went; data-audit-ux.spec.ts: audit log: money, reasons and the clock read as words, and the whole row opens its record

situation: Every row of a record's details has a name
given: a record whose context carries the nights charged, a balance recorded as text, or the id of a Folio line
then: each row has a name in the reader's language ("Nights charged at check-out"); a balance carries its currency whether it was recorded as a number or as text; the id of a Folio line, which nobody can look up, is not printed; a writer that records a fact no layout names fails the unit test
test_name: audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-01: names the nights charged and puts the currency on a balance recorded as text; audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-01: names the rows of the other writers that were printed as their keys; audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-01: does not print the id of a Folio line, which nobody can look up; audit-writers.test.ts: every fact a writer records is named, hidden or shown by the action's own layout

situation: The reason of a move is a sentence
given: a Guest's move recorded with its kind in front of the note ("guest_request: quieter room")
when: the list or the record shows the reason
then: the kind is read as a sentence in the reader's language ("The Guest asked: quieter room"), only when the record's own reasonKind says the first word is a kind; a note that merely begins like one is shown as written
test_name: audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-04 and DATA-05: the Why column; data-audit-ux.spec.ts: audit log: money, reasons and the clock read as words, and the whole row opens its record

situation: A reason that was needed and is missing
given: records that never carry a reason, and a correction, a cancellation or a move recorded without one
then: the ordinary empty reason is a dash, with the words for a screen reader, so a page of check-outs does not repeat a sentence; only a record that needed a reason and has none says "No reason recorded", on a phone too
test_name: audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-04 and DATA-05: keeps the ordinary empty reason quiet; audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-04 and DATA-05: says in words when a reason was required and is missing

situation: The whole row opens its record
given: a row of the list
when: a reader presses anywhere in the row: the reason, the time, the actor
then: the record opens; the links inside the row (the subject, the Property) still go where they say
test_name: audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-03 and DATA-06: stretches the title link over its row and lifts the subject link above it; data-audit-ux.spec.ts: audit log: money, reasons and the clock read as words, and the whole row opens its record

given: a viewer who reads the list at 375 px
then: each record is a card with what happened, when, and who, where and why labelled; a card with nothing to say in Why does not reserve room for it; nothing scrolls sideways
test_name: audit-reading.test.tsx: DATA-03 and DATA-06: lays a row out as a card below sm; data-audit-ux.spec.ts: audit log: a phone gets a card per record, with who, where and why

given: a list on its second page or later
when: the reader wants the records they just left
then: Proposed: a Newer records button beside Older records (a reverse keyset cursor), so paging is not one-way and Newest is not the only way back. Mews and Opera Cloud audit trails page both ways
